faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common questions about fire fighting & security systems in Egypt
faq.q1: What fire safety services does Xenon provide in Egypt?
faq.a1: Xenon supplies, installs and maintains fire alarm systems, sprinklers, FM200/CO2 gas suppression, fire extinguishers, CCTV, access control and electrical contracting across Egypt.
faq.q2: What's the difference between addressable and conventional fire alarm systems?
faq.a2: A conventional system identifies the zone of a fire, while an addressable system pinpoints the exact device and location — making it ideal for larger facilities such as hospitals, malls and factories.
faq.q3: Are your fire fighting systems compliant with the Egyptian Fire Code and Civil Defense?
faq.a3: Yes. All our designs and installations follow the Egyptian Fire Code (Code 305), Civil Defense requirements and international standards such as NFPA and UL/FM.
faq.q4: When should I use an FM200 vs a CO2 suppression system?
faq.a4: FM200 is a clean agent ideal for occupied, sensitive areas such as server rooms, archives and control rooms, while CO2 suits unoccupied high-risk spaces. We assess each site and recommend the right system.
faq.q5: Do you maintain and refill fire extinguishers?
faq.a5: Yes — we service, pressure-test and refill all types of fire extinguishers, and offer scheduled maintenance contracts for complete fire systems.
faq.q6: Which areas in Egypt do you cover?
faq.a6: We serve Cairo, Giza, Alexandria and all governorates, including the New Administrative Capital, 6th of October and industrial zones.

servicesFaq.title: Service FAQ
servicesFaq.subtitle: Questions about our fire fighting, security & electrical services
servicesFaq.q1: How much does a fire fighting system cost in Egypt?
servicesFaq.a1: Pricing depends on the building area, occupancy type and the systems required (alarm, sprinklers, gas suppression). After a free site survey we provide a detailed quotation compliant with the Egyptian Fire Code. Contact us for a free assessment.
servicesFaq.q2: Do you supply, install and maintain the systems, or only sell equipment?
servicesFaq.a2: We handle the full cycle: consultation, design, supply of genuine branded equipment, professional installation, testing, commissioning and ongoing maintenance contracts.
servicesFaq.q3: Can you obtain Civil Defense approval for our facility?
servicesFaq.a3: Yes. We design and document systems to the Egyptian Fire Code (305) and Civil Defense requirements, and support you through inspection and approval.
servicesFaq.q4: What fire extinguisher and cylinder services do you offer?
servicesFaq.a4: We supply, install, inspect, pressure-test and refill all types of fire extinguishers and FM200/CO2 cylinders, with scheduled maintenance to keep them compliant.
servicesFaq.q5: Do you work with both addressable and conventional fire alarm systems?
servicesFaq.a5: Yes — we install conventional systems for smaller premises and addressable systems for larger facilities such as hospitals, malls and factories that need device-level location.
servicesFaq.a6: We are an authorized IBC distributor and work with Honeywell, Hochiki, Apollo, Simplex, TYCO, Kidde, Grundfos, TOA and more — genuine, internationally certified products.
